**Crystal Palace (home) vs Everton, Premier League Matchday 25, February 15, 2025, at Selhurst Park in London (kickoff approximately 5:30 p.m. UK / 12:30 p.m. ET).**[[1]](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/crystal-palace-vs-everton-prediction-premier-league-odds-time-feb-15-2025-picks-bets-by-proven-expert/)[[2]](https://www.bettingpros.com/articles/premier-league-matchday-25-predictions-crystal-palace-vs-everton-saturday/)

This was framed as a mid-table clash with Palace in 12th (8-10-6, 34 points from 24 games) and Everton in 15th (6-9-9, 27 points from 24 games) entering the match. Both sides were defensively organized, with Palace tied for sixth-fewest goals conceded (30 in 24 games) and Everton also on 30 conceded; the two teams had the fewest combined goals scored in the league at that point (Palace 58 total, Everton 55).[[2]](https://www.bettingpros.com/articles/premier-league-matchday-25-predictions-crystal-palace-vs-everton-saturday/)

### Recent Form and Team News
- **Crystal Palace**: Strong momentum with five wins in their last six matches overall and just two losses in their prior eight league games. They had recorded five clean sheets in six matches across competitions (including back-to-back shutouts) and were showing resilience in draws against Bournemouth and Chelsea. They were seeking their first home league win of the calendar year after a 1-1 draw with Chelsea. Manager Oliver Glasner highlighted consistency and squad options amid a busier upcoming schedule.[[1]](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/crystal-palace-vs-everton-prediction-premier-league-odds-time-feb-15-2025-picks-bets-by-proven-expert/)
- **Everton**: On an unbeaten run of four matches under new manager David Moyes (wins over Leicester City, Brighton, and Tottenham; a dramatic 2-2 draw with Liverpool featuring a stoppage-time equalizer from James Tarkowski). The Liverpool result was described as confidence-boosting despite the hosts dominating possession. Everton sat 10 points clear of the relegation zone with a superior goal difference, prioritizing early safety ahead of tougher fixtures.[[1]](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/crystal-palace-vs-everton-prediction-premier-league-odds-time-feb-15-2025-picks-bets-by-proven-expert/)[[3]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2025/2/14/24365829/crystal-palace-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-iliman-ndiaye-injury-latest-abdoulaye-doucoure-ban)

**Injuries and suspensions (pre-match, as of Feb 14, 2025)**: Everton faced notable absences, including Iliman Ndiaye (medial knee ligament injury, out for “weeks”), Abdoulaye Doucoure (suspended after a post-match second yellow in the Liverpool derby), and longer-term issues for Nathan Patterson, Orel Mangala, Dominic Calvert-Lewin, Seamus Coleman, Armando Broja, Youssef Chermiti, and Dwight McNeil. Palace’s injury situation was not highlighted as a major concern in previews, with emphasis on their depth and recent clean-sheet form.[[3]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2025/2/14/24365829/crystal-palace-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-iliman-ndiaye-injury-latest-abdoulaye-doucoure-ban)

### Head-to-Head History
Everton held a strong recent edge, remaining unbeaten in their last eight meetings across all competitions and winning four of the last six domestic fixtures. Historically, Everton dominated at Selhurst Park, with Palace securing just one win in the previous 20 meetings (a 3-1 victory in November 2021 under Rafa Benítez). The October 2024 meeting (Everton 2-1 Palace) was part of this trend.[[1]](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/crystal-palace-vs-everton-prediction-premier-league-odds-time-feb-15-2025-picks-bets-by-proven-expert/)[[3]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2025/2/14/24365829/crystal-palace-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-iliman-ndiaye-injury-latest-abdoulaye-doucoure-ban)

### Venue, Travel, Fatigue, and Other Factors
- **Home advantage and venue**: Selhurst Park offered Palace typical home support and familiarity. No unusual pitch, altitude, or climate issues were noted for this standard London venue.[[1]](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/crystal-palace-vs-everton-prediction-premier-league-odds-time-feb-15-2025-picks-bets-by-proven-expert/)
- **Travel and fatigue**: Everton traveled from Liverpool (roughly 200 miles south), a manageable distance but potentially tiring after their intense midweek Merseyside derby against Liverpool. Previews noted the possibility of “heavy legs” for the visitors.[[3]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2025/2/14/24365829/crystal-palace-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-iliman-ndiaye-injury-latest-abdoulaye-doucoure-ban)
- **Other storylines**: Everton’s revival and push for Premier League safety under Moyes contrasted with Palace’s push for consistency and upward momentum. Both teams’ defensive solidity pointed toward a low-scoring affair (previews heavily favored the under 2.5 goals). Palace aimed to exploit any post-derby fatigue, while Everton sought to maintain their positive trajectory.[[2]](https://www.bettingpros.com/articles/premier-league-matchday-25-predictions-crystal-palace-vs-everton-saturday/)[[3]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2025/2/14/24365829/crystal-palace-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-iliman-ndiaye-injury-latest-abdoulaye-doucoure-ban)

All details above derive from previews and reports published on or before February 15, 2025. No post-match outcomes or later-season information were used.

factors.factor: Everton's significant injury and suspension crisis
factors.impact: Severely handicaps Everton with multiple key players out (Ndiaye, Doucoure suspended, Calvert-Lewin, McNeil, etc.), impacting midfield depth, attacking options, and overall squad strength. This is a major advantage for Crystal Palace.
Playing an intense Merseyside derby midweek may lead to 'heavy legs' and reduced stamina for Everton, further exacerbated by their squad issues, benefiting the fresher Palace side.

factors.factor: Crystal Palace's strong recent form and defensive solidity
factors.impact: Five wins in six matches and five clean sheets in six across competitions demonstrate excellent momentum and defensive organization for Palace, providing a strong foundation for this match.

factors.factor: Crystal Palace's healthy squad and depth
factors.impact: With no major injury concerns highlighted, Palace has full squad options, contrasting sharply with Everton's depleted roster and providing a competitive edge.

Historically, Everton has a very strong advantage, unbeaten in eight and only one Palace win in 20 meetings at Selhurst Park. This pattern suggests a mental and tactical edge, which cannot be entirely discounted despite current circumstances.

factors.factor: Home advantage for Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park
factors.impact: Standard home support and familiarity provide a marginal boost to Crystal Palace.

analysis.reasoning: While Everton holds a historically significant head-to-head advantage, remaining unbeaten in their last eight meetings and dominating at Selhurst Park for two decades, current circumstances heavily shift the favor towards Crystal Palace. Everton arrives severely depleted by a major injury crisis, missing key players like Iliman Ndiaye, Abdoulaye Doucoure (suspended), and several long-term absentees including Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Dwight McNeil. This is compounded by potential fatigue following an intense midweek Merseyside derby. Conversely, Crystal Palace is in excellent form, boasting five wins in their last six matches and an impressive five clean sheets across competitions, with a healthy squad and good depth. Although the historical H2H cannot be ignored, the sheer scale of Everton's current player absences and potential physical disadvantage gives Palace a tangible and significant edge in this specific matchup, overriding a portion of Everton's past dominance. Therefore, a moderate adjustment favoring Crystal Palace is warranted.
